services.name: Morning Magic Kealakekua Bay Kayak & Snorkel Tour
services.desc: Join us for an amazing 5 hour kayak and snorkel tour in Kealakekua Bay. 4.5 Hours About We are proud to share the history, culture, and natural beauty of this area with our guests! Description: Our certified guides will accompany you on a paddle across the calm waters of Kealakekua Bay while we share the interesting and rich Hawaiian and natural history of the area. We’ll keep an eye out for Nai’a (Hawaiian spinner dolphins) which frequent the area and sometimes put on a show, and whales (in season). services.name: Midday Meander: Kealakekua Bay Kayak and Snorkel Tour
services.desc: Sleep in, have a relaxing morning and then join Kona Boys for an accompanied paddle and snorkel in Kealakekua Bay. 4 Hours About We take care of the logistics and you enjoy three hours of paddling and snorkeling that are sure to be one of your best experiences on the Big Island. We set you up with snorkel gear and give you a quick history lesson before you meet our certified guide for a spectacular paddle across the most protected deep water bay in the Hawaiian Islands. services.desc: Stand up paddling is the fastest growing water-sport in the world…and it all started right here in Hawaii! 1.5 hour lesson About Paddle boarding originated in Hawaii, so leave the shore behind and join Kona Boys for a paddle. We offer lessons for those just getting their sea legs and paddle board historical tours for the more experienced. services.name: Wa’a (Hawaiian Outrigger Canoe) Rides
services.desc: Join us and learn the basics of paddling and some local history while touring Kailua Bay! 1 hour About There is a special feeling that accompanies paddling a traditional Hawaiian Wa’a from the shores of Kamakahonu. Enjoy Kona’s amazing waters and beautiful coastline in the tradition of the Hawaiians themselves. Our guide/steersman will give you a beach-side orientation before we board the Wa’a and launch from the protected beach at Kamakahonu Bay.
